errors.evidence: The description lists all 20 numerical values from the chart verbatim. This level of detail is excessive and contrary to the prompt's instruction to provide representative values, which makes the text difficult to read.

errors.text_span: Някои от стълбите са визуално разграничени чрез различни цветове според легендата.
errors.evidence: This sentence is redundant as it repeats information already provided earlier in the description, which states that each of the four bars per year is colored according to four different categories.

The description states that "some of the bars" are distinguished by color, which is an understatement. In fact, all bars are colored according to the legend to represent the four different data series.
